general.description: ONERA M6 wing, SA RANS: M 0.84, alpha 3.06 deg, Re 14.6e6 per root chord (NASA TMR case 2308)

domain.notes: One 3D block of 16 x 44 x 24 cells (16,896), in this directory: the fifth level of NASA TMR's structured ONERA M6 family (root chord 1, semispan 1.476, far field at 100 chords), coarse enough to run anywhere. Finer levels: data/grids/README.md. Patches are named by box rules: the root plane y = 0, the wing inside a box, the rest far field. Reference area (the semispan planform), length (the mean aerodynamic chord) and moment centre as in TMR's runs.

freestream.notes: In 3D the incidence is in the x-z plane: x chordwise, y along the span, z up.
